**The performer of “Night Rocker” – David Hasselhoff – played the role of Dr. William “Snapper” Foster Jr. on *The Young and the Restless*.**  

- **Character:** Dr. Snapper Foster (often billed as Dr. William “Snapper” Foster Jr.)  
- **Show:** *The Young and the Restless* (CBS daytime soap)  
- **Years on the show:** 1975–1982 (and brief returns later).  

David Hasselhoff first gained fame on the soap opera, portraying the young, charismatic doctor before moving on to his iconic roles in *Knight Rider* and *Baywatch*.
